english.title: Designated premises supervisor allow children in relevant premises between 2400 and 0500 hours - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the designated premises supervisor for **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES AND LOCATION..), allowed an unaccompanied child to be on the premises between the hours of midnight and 5 am when they were open for the supply of alcohol for consumption there
english.legislation: Contrary to section 145(1)(b), (3)(b)(ii) and (9) of the Licensing Act 2003.

english.notes:
(i) See section 145(4) for the premises to which the offence relates
(ii) See section 145(2) for the meaning of the term "child".
(iii) See sections 145(5) and (6) for the defences.
